Provide day-to-day administrative support for RJED housing maintenance activities, including job requests, work orders, schedules, checklists, filing, data entry and reporting information.
Assist with the coordination of maintenance jobs, inspections, trades visits, cleaning tasks, participant work activities and follow-up actions as directed by the supervisor.

Maintain accurate records of attendance, job progress, materials, equipment, photos, purchase order information, invoices, safety paperwork and completed works.

Communicate respectfully with residents, families, BHAC staff, trades, suppliers, participants and other stakeholders about maintenance arrangements, access, appointments and job progress.
Support trades and maintenance staff with safe non-licensed tasks, including site preparation, carrying materials, organizing tools and equipment, collecting supplies, cleaning, pack down and basic maintenance assistance under supervision.

Undertake cleaning of houses, work areas, amenities, yards, vehicles and equipment associated with housing maintenance activities, ensuring sites are safe, tidy and ready for works or handover.
Assist with stock, tools, PPE and materials management, including ordering requests, issue and return registers, storage, checking supplies, reporting damage or loss and helping keep work areas organized.
Support RJED participants and Indigenous employees engaged in housing maintenance activities to understand attendance, routines, PPE, safety requirements, respectful conduct and workplace expectations.
Identify and report practical barriers, urgent maintenance issues, hazards, damage, resident concerns or other matters requiring supervisor, trades, housing or management follow-up.
Protect confidentiality and privacy when working in or around people’s homes and when handling records, photos, personal information or maintenance-related documents.

This position does not come with housing.

Enoggera Health Centre, located at Gallipoli Barracks in Brisbane, is the primary base for this position and supports nearby facilities including Victoria, Bulimba, and Damascus Barracks. Established in 1908, Gallipoli Barracks is the largest military base in South Queensland, home to approximately 8,000 members and the Deployable Joint Force Headquarters.
Australian citizenship is a mandatory requirement for this role. This fulltime position is primarily Monday to Friday (day shifts) and offers the opportunity to work as part of a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
Casual and parttime 0.4 positions are also available. 
What you will do
Keep the clinic running smoothly by providing fast, accurate, and professional clerical and administrative support to health staff and patients.
Manage electronic and hard copy health records and data in accordance with Defence policies, privacy requirements, and compliance standards.
Coordinate appointments and liaise effectively with internal and external health service providers to support continuity of care and timely access to patient information.
Prepare reports, update health and personnel management systems, and assist with auditing activities to support operational and compliance requirements.
Support day-to-day clinic operations through filing, mail distribution, photocopying, ordering stationery and stores, and processing supply requests.
What you bring
Minimum of 1 year of fulltime (or parttime equivalent) experience in an administrative role. (Medical setting highly desirable)
Completion of a medical terminology course from a Registered Training Organisation (RTO), or willingness to complete
Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
Sound computer literacy and experience with electronic health record systems highly regarded.
